notes.title: Decryption gameplay collection
notes.content:
Dear players:
Sincerely invite you to give us your ideas on the gameplay and art style of the secret room. I will prepare new secret rooms based on the players' suggestions, and everyone is welcome to participate.

notes.title: Online Testing Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am Program JM Ming. I am delighted to announce that the first independent game, Secret City Tycoon, will soon be available to all players. Three people took 7 months to complete the first test version of this product, except for me, SM Li, and MG Fei, who have put in a lot of effort. Anyway, we have created an independent and beloved game. I am an 80s programmer and a 999 purity room puzzle player. I love solving puzzles and am loyal to the room. I have participated in many game projects, but most of them are not of a type that I fully recognize or cannot be satisfied with for some reason. Therefore, I have decided to give it a try myself.
[h2] The Secret City Tycoon has a variety of gameplay options, including mini games, puzzle solving, and multiple secret rooms presented from different perspectives, horror, suspense, warmth, multiple endings, and more. We have planned many more contents in the future, but we hope to first collect suggestions from players to better meet their needs and complete the work. We look forward to receiving feedback, suggestions, and ideas from all players. We welcome puzzle solving experts to feel free to contact me anytime. [/h2]
